```{=html}
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="fr">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Outfit:wght@400;700;900&family=Inter:wght@300;400;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

    body {
      min-height: 100vh;
      background: #0D0F1A;
      font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      overflow: hidden;
      color: #F1F5F9;
    }

    body::before {
      content: '';
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 60% at 15% 20%, rgba(124,58,237,0.2) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 80% at 85% 80%, rgba(6,182,212,0.13) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 40% at 50% 50%, rgba(16,185,129,0.07) 0%, transparent 70%);
    }

    .landing {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      text-align: center;
      padding: 3rem 2rem;
      max-width: 720px;
      width: 100%;
    }

    .badge {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.22em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #7C3AED;
      border: 1px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.4);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 0.35em 1.2em;
      margin-bottom: 2rem;
      background: rgba(124,58,237,0.08);
      animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease 0.1s both;
    }

    h1 {
      font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
      font-size: clamp(2.6rem, 5vw, 4rem);
      font-weight: 900;
      letter-spacing: -0.04em;
      line-height: 1;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #a78bfa 0%, #7C3AED 30%, #06B6D4 65%, #10B981 100%);
      background-size: 200% 200%;
      -webkit-background-clip: text;
      -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
      background-clip: text;
      margin-bottom: 0.8rem;
      animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease 0.2s both, gradientShift 6s ease infinite;
    }

    .subtitle {
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: #94A3B8;
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 0.4rem;
      animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease 0.3s both;
    }

    .audience {
      font-size: 0.62rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #7C3AED;
      opacity: 0.85;
      margin-bottom: 3rem;
      animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease 0.35s both;
    }

    .cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 1rem;
      padding: 1.3rem 3rem;
      border-radius: 18px;
      text-decoration: none;
      font-family: 'Outfit', sans-serif;
      font-weight: 700;
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      color: #F1F5F9;
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(124,58,237,0.22), rgba(6,182,212,0.1));
      border: 1.5px solid rgba(124,58,237,0.55);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 30px rgba(124,58,237,0.22);
      transition: transform 0.22s ease, box-shadow 0.25s ease, border-color 0.22s ease;
      animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease 0.45s both;
    }

    .cta:hover {
      transform: translateY(-5px);
      border-color: rgba(124,58,237,0.95);
      box-shadow: 0 14px 55px rgba(124,58,237,0.38), 0 0 0 4px rgba(124,58,237,0.08);
    }

    .cta .flag { font-size: 1.8rem; line-height: 1; }

    .cta .lbl {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      text-align: left;
      gap: 0.1rem;
    }

    .cta .lbl .name { font-size: 1.1rem; font-weight: 800; }
    .cta .lbl .sub  { font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 400; opacity: 0.7; }

    .divider {
      width: 50px;
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.12), transparent);
      margin: 2.2rem auto;
      animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease 0.55s both;
    }

    .acts {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.7rem;
      justify-content: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      animation: fadeUp 0.5s ease 0.6s both;
    }

    .pill {
      font-size: 0.58rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.32em 1em;
      border-radius: 20px;
      border: 1px solid;
    }

    .p1 { color: #7C3AED; border-color: rgba(124,58,237,0.4); background: rgba(124,58,237,0.1); }
    .p2 { color: #06B6D4; border-color: rgba(6,182,212,0.4); background: rgba(6,182,212,0.1); }
    .p3 { color: #10B981; border-color: rgba(16,185,129,0.4); background: rgba(16,185,129,0.1); }

    @keyframes fadeUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(22px); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    @keyframes gradientShift {
      0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
      50%       { background-position: 100% 50%; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="landing">
    <div class="badge">Des Prompts aux Produits</div>

    <h1>LLMs &amp; IA Agentique</h1>

    <p class="subtitle">
      Une présentation pédagogique sur les LLMs et l'IA Agentique<br>
      à destination des Product Managers, POs et praticiens de la donnée.
    </p>
    <p class="audience">Pour PMs &amp; POs · Statisticiens &amp; Data Practitioners</p>

    <a class="cta" href="fr.html">
      <span class="flag">🇫🇷</span>
      <span class="lbl">
        <span class="name">Voir la présentation</span>
        <span class="sub">Version française · ~45 min</span>
      </span>
    </a>

    <div class="divider"></div>

    <div class="acts">
      <span class="pill p1">ACT I · La Couche Intelligence</span>
      <span class="pill p2">ACT II · La Couche Agentique</span>
      <span class="pill p3">ACT III · Agents &amp; Product Boards</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</body>
</html>
```
